anonymous_statement : ∀
  {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ I → ℝ) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ I),
  (∀ (h : EuclideanSpace ℝ I), (fderiv ℝ (fun x => f (-x)) w) h = -(fderiv ℝ f (-w)) h) ∧
    object_1 (fun x => f (-x)) w =
      object_1 f (-w)
approved_definition_context:
def object_1.{u_1} : {I : Type u_1} →
  [Fintype I] → (EuclideanSpace ℝ I → ℝ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ I → ℝ :=
fun {I} [Fintype I] f w =>
  Laplacian.laplacian f w - ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) w) w) w - ↑(Fintype.card I - 1) * (fderiv ℝ f w) w

EuclideanSpace R I is the finite-dimensional real Euclidean coordinate space with its standard inner product. fderiv R is the total Frechet derivative: outside differentiability its value is zero. Laplacian.laplacian is the actual finite orthonormal-basis contraction of the total second derivative. A derivative occurrence is not a separate assertion of classical differentiability. The printed subtraction Fintype.card I - 1 occurs in N before the cast to R. Negation of points and directions is literal vector negation.
